Resubmission note (to the milestone reviewers)
This milestone previously received one approval and one request for revision. The revision request asked for two things: (1) a linked written record confirming that the scope change (in-person town halls → LMS delivery; CardanoSpot → Cardano Forum) was formally sanctioned, and (2) clarification on the Twitch live-streaming component. Both are addressed below, and all Output A–E evidence is included again unchanged.
1. The scope change was formally approved by Project Catalyst
The full Catalyst correspondence is attached as Catalyst_Scope_Change_Agreement.pdf (Zendesk ticket / email chain for project 1100128). The relevant confirmations:
・Approved change request dated 4 June 2024. On 25 June 2026, Catalyst Support wrote: "we would like to confirm that the approved change request is the one dated 4 June 2024, which is visible in the Milestone Module." This is the change request that moved delivery away from the "after town halls" format and set the online course (wisdom.courses / blocklaunchinstitute.com) as the destination.
・Milestone Module: https://milestones.projectcatalyst.io/projects/1100128
・Approved change request document: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1TbO-PhS81Ovfh8R5eV4TDSoevsPpAKjv/view?usp=sharing
